description.ja: 遅延割引とは、報酬を得るまでの待ち時間が長くなるほど、その報酬の主観的価値が低下する心理現象を指します。例えば「今すぐ1万円」と「1年後に1万5千円」を比較したとき、多くの人は待ち時間のために後者の価値を割り引いて評価します。衝動性や自己制御、依存症研究などで重要な指標として用いられます。
description.en: Delay discounting refers to the psychological phenomenon where the subjective value of a reward decreases as the delay to receiving it increases. For example, when comparing 'receive $100 now' versus 'receive $150 in one year,' many people discount the value of the delayed reward due to the waiting time. It serves as an important measure in research on impulsivity, self-control, and addiction.

usage.ja: 論文では選択課題(例:即時の小報酬 vs 遅延のある大報酬)を用いて測定され、双曲割引関数などの数理モデルでk値(割引率)を算出します。物質使用障害、ADHD、肥満などの研究で、急峻な割引(高いk値)が衝動的行動と関連することが調べられています。
usage.en: In research papers, it is measured using choice tasks (e.g., immediate small reward vs. delayed large reward), and mathematical models such as hyperbolic discounting functions are used to calculate the k-value (discount rate). Studies on substance use disorders, ADHD, and obesity examine how steeper discounting (higher k-values) relates to impulsive behavior.

synonyms.ja: 時間割引、temporal discountingとも呼ばれます。類似概念に確率割引(probability discounting、不確実性による価値低下)がありますが、遅延割引は時間要因に特化した指標です。impulsive choice(衝動的選択)の客観的測定法としても位置づけられます。
synonyms.en: Also called temporal discounting or intertemporal choice. A related concept is probability discounting (value reduction due to uncertainty), but delay discounting specifically focuses on the temporal factor. It is also positioned as an objective measure of impulsive choice.
